profile.headline: Project Lead and Software Engineer at ISA
profile.summary:
Specialties: Administartor of Oracle9i Application Server (Oracle9iAS )
Certifide training in Enterprise JavaBeans Programming SL-351

positions.title: Project Lead/Software Engineer
positions.description:
With ISA I'm tasked as project lead, managing development of a military j2ee program that will provide office automation through web services. 
  With a RAD development approach, I assess business processes for reengineering or technology insertion, training personnel, examining doctrinal and policy implications, coordinating joint and defining the operational requirements to be supported by physical resources and systems, e.g., communications throughput, specific node-to-node interoperability levels, information transaction time windows, and security protection needed.
The Infrastructure for this project is structured around Oracle 10g clustering concept, including application replication of the presentation, business, and data tier. The application server software provides a majority of this support.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Used J2EE architecture to develop middleware for the Enterprise Environmental Safety and Occupational Health Management Information System (EESOH-MIS) software.  Developed Enterprise Java Beans, as well as various classes and business components.  Used Object Oriented programming, ORACLE databases as well as an understanding of each of the Environmental Business functions.  The design incorporated Jakarta Struts and Java Data Objects using Toplink data mapping.  The architecture was deployed on Oracle 9i Application Server.
